summary: Practise equipment inspection, DRC calculations and appraisal reporting in a five-day course. Explore the syllabus and plan your training.
lede: Plant and machinery valuation covers how fixed-asset professionals, valuers and finance teams assess equipment and prepare supportable appraisals. You’ll practise reconciling asset registers, recording inspection and condition evidence, selecting cost, market or income approaches, assessing depreciation and obsolescence, and documenting assumptions in a concise report.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who inspect, value, record or make decisions about plant and machinery assets. It suits people with working familiarity in fixed assets, valuation, finance or equipment operations.
modules: Plant Valuation Integration and Action Planning
prerequisites: Working familiarity with fixed-asset records, equipment operations, valuation or financial reporting is recommended. No programming is required; exercises use valuation concepts and spreadsheet calculations.
